title: The characteristic polynomial is monic of degree the dimension
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $V$ a finite-dimensional $K$-vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace] of dimension $n=\dim_KV$ [def-weil-vector-space-dimension], $F:V\to V$ a $K$-linear endomorphism, and $\chi_F(T)=\det(T-F\mid V)\in K[T]$ its characteristic polynomial [def-weil-characteristic-polynomial]. Then $\chi_F$ is monic of degree $n$: $[T^n]\chi_F=1$ and $[T^k]\chi_F=0$ for $k>n$ [def-weil-polynomial-coefficient].
